Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for anyone who trained herself to expect the worst.

He:: Jesus... I've been looking down so long, I flinched when things went right. 🌤️
He:: The call came. The report came. My first thought was, what goes wrong next?
Jesus: You braced for the storm so long, you forgot storms end.
He:: But last time it started turning, it turned right back. I can't carry another almost.
Jesus: A season turning is a signal, not a trick. When things begin to move, lift your head.
